info.title: OutReign API
info.summary: B2B lead intelligence and outbound sales API
info.description:
The OutReign REST API lets your server read and manage the data in an OutReign account: saved leads, pipeline deals, activities and contacts. It can also enrich and score saved leads and generate AI email drafts.

**Base URL:** `https://api.outreign.io/rest-api`

**Authentication:** send your key in the `X-API-Key` header. Create keys in OutReign under Settings → API Keys. API access is included on Starter and above.

**Format:** JSON request and response bodies, UTF-8. Single records are returned in `data`; lists return `data`, `count`, `limit` and `offset`. Errors return `error` with a message.

**Scope:** Fresh B2B prospect search, company search, person lookup, email verification and saved-lead research use the same app handlers and account restrictions. Nothing is automatically saved or sent by discovery. See https://docs.outreign.io/developer-docs/capabilities.

MCP (for AI assistants) and webhooks are documented at https://docs.outreign.io.

tags.description: Saved leads: the people and companies you prospect. Enrichment adds verified contact and company data; scoring rates fit and intent against your ICP.

tags.name: Deals

get.description: List saved leads, newest first. Filter by `industry` or `status`, and page with `limit` and `offset`. This reads leads already saved in your account; it does not search for new prospects.

post.description: Save a new lead to your account. `contact_name` and `company_name` are required. Creating a lead does not enrich it or send outreach; call Enrich a lead afterwards if you need verified contact data.

Import up to 100 leads in one request. Each entry is validated on its own: valid leads are saved and invalid ones are reported in `errors` by their position in the array, so a partial import still returns 201. Check `failed` before assuming every lead was saved.

post.description: Generate a draft, not a sent email. Send a lead object plus tone and goal; leadId alone is not accepted by the generator. Supply your own sender/business context. Inspect JSON error even on HTTP 200.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Your secret API key. Create it in OutReign → Settings → API Keys and send it on every request as `X-API-Key: <key>`. The key acts as its owner: every request reads and writes that owner's data. Keep it server-side; never ship it in browser or mobile code.

Error.description: Error body returned with every non-2xx status.

error.description: Human-readable explanation. Safe to log; never contains your key.

resetAt.description: Present on rate-limit errors: when you can retry.

available.description: Present on unknown-resource errors: the valid resources.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current per-minute window for this key and resource.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: ISO 8601 time when the window refills.

BadRequest.description: The body is not valid JSON or a required field is missing.

Unauthorized.description: The `X-API-Key` header is missing, or the key is invalid, inactive or expired.

Forbidden.description: Your plan does not include API access, or the daily allowance is used up.

example.error: API access is included on Starter and above. Upgrade your plan to use the API.

NotFound.description: No record with this ID exists in your account.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Wait until `resetAt` before retrying.

ServerError.description: Unexpected failure. Retry reads with backoff; read a record back before retrying a write.
